# Sustainology

> > Sustainology provides comprehensive sustainability consulting services including green building certifications (LEED, IGBC, GRIHA, GEM), carbon footprint reduction, CSR initiatives, environmental compliance, and GRI-based sustainability reporting across India and North America.

Sustainology specializes in helping organizations achieve environmental goals through certifications from bodies like the U.S. Green Building Council and Global Reporting Initiative. The firm works with major clients including Chandigarh University and Trident Group, offering solutions ranging from wastewater treatment to sustainable transportation and climate action strategies.

## Key Topics

- LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design)
- GRI (Global Reporting Initiative)
- Green building certifications
- Carbon footprint reduction
- CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility)
- Environmental compliance
- Sustainability reporting
- Climate action
- GEM certification
- IGBC and GRIHA standards
- Carbon budgets
- Community engagement
- Renewable energy
- Greenhouse gas emissions
- Building retrofits and energy efficiency

## Green Building Certifications

- [Green Building Certifications](https://sustainology360.com/services/green-building-certifications): IGBC, GRIHA, LEED, and GEM building certification services
- [LEED](https://sustainology360.com/services/green-building-certifications/leed): LEED certification services by USGBC for green building design
- [GEM](https://sustainology360.com/services/green-building-certifications/gem-2): GEM certification program by ASSOCHAM for green buildings in India

## CSR & Sustainability Initiatives

- [CSR & Sustainability Initiatives](https://sustainology360.com/services/csr-sustainability-initiatives): Corporate social responsibility and environmental sustainability services
- [Community Participant](https://sustainology360.com/services/csr-sustainability-initiatives/community-participant): CSR community engagement and participation services by Sustainology
- [Wastewater Treatment Plants](https://sustainology360.com/services/csr-sustainability-initiatives/wastewater-treatment-plants): Industrial and domestic wastewater treatment CSR services
